messages:
Andrea (AE): quick sync — Legal closed the enterprise commit with EdgeCo today. They want 99th pctl latency guarantees for chat at 50 rps, but expect 10k rps spikes from their CDN during promos. Need presales runbook: reserved GPUs, autoscale tiers, and how edge rate-limiter ties into capacity.
Mike S.: congrats. do we have their traffic profile? burst duration, concurrency per user?
Andrea (AE): high-level: baseline 50 rps steady, typical request = 200 tokens in/out, bursts last 3–6 minutes, maybe 4–5x baseline for short windows. they also require AZ failover.
Jyoti (Infra): ok. quick math: 50 rps * 200 tokens = 10k tokens/s baseline. at our g4dn-like instances with quantized model ~ 15k tokens/s per GPU (in ideal batching), so baseline could be 1 GPU, but bursts up to 10k rps (~2M tokens/s) need ~130 GPUs naive. with KV caching and batching we can reduce by ~3-4x.
Samir (SRE): important: their SLO is tail-latency (99th) at <300ms. That rules out heavy queueing. We should propose warm reserved pool for baseline + a tiered autoscale policy for bursts with prewarm and fast add/remove.
Luis (Solutions): I'll draft the presales playbook. question: are they ok with degraded quality fallback (smaller model / lower seq len) at extreme surge? Pricing will reflect fallback usage.
Andrea (AE): they said yes to graceful degradation if it's opt-in. prefer model fallback over failed requests.
Mike S.: propose config draft: reserved: 2 GPUs pinned per AZ for baseline and hot cache; autoscale tiers: immediate burst pool (prewarmed, uses reserved capacity credit) up to 20 GPUs, then spot/ephemeral up to 200 GPUs with slower spin-up. Also edge rate-limiter rules: CDN will shard traffic to our ingress; need request shaping at ingress so autoscale has headroom.
Jyoti (Infra): sample autoscale policy snippet I suggest to include in the doc:
```
policy:
  - name: immediate-burst
    trigger: rps_delta > 200% over 30s
    action: bring_up_prewarm(20)
    cooldown: 120s
  - name: sustained-scale
    trigger: rps > baseline*3 for 5m
    action: scale_to_approx(tokens/sec_needed / per_gpu_capacity)
    cooldown: 300s
```
Samir (SRE): add AZ spread and eviction tolerance tags. fallback-route should route >95% of traffic to fallback model if queue depth > threshold. Also KV warmup: prewarm keys via synthetic traffic during preheat window.
Andrea (AE): pricing ask from customer: how do reserved credits vs burst credits work? They want an example bill for a month with 6 promo spikes (6x 10k rps for 5 minutes).
Luis (Solutions): I'll run the numbers and include two scenarios in the quote: (A) reserved-heavy: pay for reserved pool sized for baseline+immediate-burst 20 GPUs (monthly commit) + small usage overage; (B) commit-min + burst credits: lower monthly, burst credits used for spikes. I'll add sample cost calc.
Mike S.: ops detail: we need an ops runbook entry for on-call handoff during promos and an autoscale run verification play: smoke test to ensure KV cache warms within 60s and fallback is triggered correctly.
Andrea (AE): perfect. Samir/Jyoti — can you both provide one-page bullet technical requirements (AZs, prewarm window, KV warmup steps, circuit-breaker thresholds) by EOD? I'll attach to the security questionnaire and hand to procurement.
Samir (SRE): on it.
Jyoti (Infra): sending a short checklist shortly.
ops-bot: Deploy plan created: https://deploys.redwood/edgeco-presales/5543219876 - ping @infra @sre
Andrea (AE): thanks everyone :thumbsup: we’ll review draft playbook in tomorrow’s presales sync at 10am.
